question: One pipe can fill a tank in 2 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 4 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-fourth of the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM(2, 4) = 4 units.

Efficiency of inlet pipe = +2 units/min and outlet pipe = −1 unit/min.

Net efficiency when both are open = 2 − 1 = +1 unit/min.

Required capacity to be filled = 1/4 of total = 1/4 × 4 = 1 unit.

Time required = 1 ÷ 1 = 1 minute.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 minute.**
